The Glass Orchestra will perform at the Victoria Hall on Friday 9 November. Doors open at 7pm and the concert starts at 7:30pm.

The hall has a cloakroom and a bar. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult.

The nearest car park is on Queen Street.
